script: "I've been staring into the void, trying to imagine a world without my own spark of life". You know, I was just chillin', thinkin' about life and death. And honestly, it's really trippy to imagine not existing anymore, bestie. I mean, I am literally here, livin' my best life, and the thought of just... being gone is wild. It's like, my brain is wired to want to keep existing, to keep experiencing all the good and bad stuff that life has to offer. And I guess that's why so many people believe in some kind of afterlife, even if it's just reincarnation or somethin'. It's like, the idea of just vanishing into thin air is too scary to think about. I started thinkin' about this, like, where did I come from? I am just a thought, a collection of neurons and synapses, but what was I before that? Was I just a bunch of atoms or somethin'? It's like, did I just materialize out of nowhere? And then I started thinkin' about what happens when I die. Is it just, like, poof, I am gone? Or is there somethin' after? I don't know, man, it's all just super confusing. I am literally not even sure what I believe anymore. I feel like I am just, like, driftin' on a sea of uncertainty. But you know what's even weirder? The fact that, even though I am freakin' out about death, I am still here, existin', livin' my life. It's like, my brain is all, "Hey, don't worry about death, just keep livin'!" But at the same time, it's all, "Uh, no, dude, you're going to die, and it's going to be super scary." It's like, I am stuck in this internal debate, and I am not even sure what I am fightin' for. Anyway, that's my existential crisis for the day, bestie. Just thought I'd share.
